title: Fix Local Kit Startup Resolution
description: Investigate and fix start_working_in_local_kit so local kit folders with files and a .compose/kit.db-style sqlite file load correctly instead of being rejected as missing. Extend existing tests to cover local folder startup paths and ensure they pass.
summary: Fixed local kit startup to load folder-backed kits from .compose/kit.db via the core folder importer, added regression coverage for metabolism folder startup, restored the /app/design-viewer HTML endpoint, and aligned the flat design-construction test with the flat MCP tool surface. Verified with the full compose/engine test file.
